reviews.author: scottschurr
reviews.body: :+1: Looks like a good solution.  I feel no need for a regression test showing the failure mode.  I made a small suggestion for a possible test improvement, but it's not required.

reviewCommentsList.author: scottschurr
reviewCommentsList.body: I have a suggestion for your unit tests.  Since both `featurePayChan` and `fix1512` are in the `supportedAmendments` list, consider omitting the `with_features`.  Env will automatically give you both of the amendments you need.  You'll have the side benefit that you'll be running the tests with all of the other supported amendments as well, and pick up new amendments as they are added over time.
